name: print-social-phone-product-ad-purple-gradient
title: Purple gradient smartphone product ad
whatItIs: A square ad for a flagship phone tilted at an angle over a soft purple-to-green gradient, with spec callouts for camera, screen and processor placed around it.
whatItMeans: Angling the product and scattering short spec tags around it (rather than a dense spec sheet) keeps the ad feeling premium and easy to scan at a glance.
techniques: tilt the hero product off-axis for dynamism instead of a flat frontal shot
place short spec callouts in loose orbit around the product rather than in a table
use an ambient color gradient background instead of a solid or photographic backdrop

vocabulary.definition: a short label pointing to a specific detail or feature within a larger image
